note: Real export shipments are documented with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (Argentina, UK, UAE, Tanzania), so export_status = confirmed on customs records, not on website claims. Note the same ImportKey page mixes import rows (scrap inbound from Mauritius/US) with export rows — only the outbound rows were counted as export evidence. Domestic (India) supply evidence is missing from public sources, so it is recorded as unknown rather than declared_only. Revenue/export volume figures: null (not public in retrieved sources).
